pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   C. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. Say Kalpasutra and Dhammapada has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.

5. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   D. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Specific morning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Specific morning has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Specific morning with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Specific morning to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Specific morning.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   B. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Myself has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Qualities of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Qualities of has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities of.
   D. Apply the teaching of Qualities of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Specific morning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Qualities of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Kalpasutra and Dhammapada and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
